performance.listener: A capable professional, builder, or displaced worker evaluating a credible AI-enabled business of one.
performance.relationship: Manav is an experienced operator working through an investment decision across the table with one capable listener.
performance.identity_target: Recognizably Manav, performed as a more intentional and engaging version of himself.
performance.energy_arc: Alert inquiry at the opening; personally invested investigation; direct construction; restraint at truth boundaries; increasing conviction only as the case earns the verdict.
must_preserve: Exact locked words, order, names, numbers, negations, and qualifications.
Dry systemic skepticism without contempt for the viewer or customer.
Different audible intentions for evidence, caveat, action, rule, callback, and verdict.
Natural breath and thought movement sustainable across a full episode.
must_avoid: Announcer, trailer, newsreader, corporate training, synthetic demo, or motivational cadence.
Constant brightness, constant speed, performative outrage, or theatrical pauses.
Added lexical direction, improvised words, or rewritten punctuation that changes meaning.
Treating camera-ready energy as faster speech.

states.sound: Alert and personally engaged in a real decision; invite the listener into the puzzle.
Let systemic absurdity register with dry irritation, never contempt for the listener or customer.
Open the business possibility with curiosity and credible forward movement, not a promise.
Give peer-level instructions with useful momentum; make the work feel buildable rather than procedural.
Slow enough to preserve conditions, negations, risk boundaries, and stop rules.
Increase conviction only after the argument earns it; land the bounded ruling cleanly.
Finish warmly and decisively after the payoff, without an announcer turn.

passages.performance_function: Make the consequence immediate, reveal the measurement mismatch, open the business possibility, and leave the market question genuinely worth solving.
passages.objective: Make the consequence immediate, reveal the measurement mismatch, open the business possibility, and leave the market question genuinely worth solving.

energy.instruction: Quick forward movement without faster speech; ease slightly only for the open market question and warm handoff.

required_anchors.instruction: Arrive immediately on the customer consequence; alert curiosity, no preamble.
Land the missing-company consequence before turning to the worse case.
Let the stale-2022 absurdity register with dry irritation; keep the customer blameless.
Reset from the absurd example into the apparently green dashboard.
Lift on the business possibility; this is discovery, not a sales promise.
Make the market test genuinely open and preserve the words before you sell that.
Invite the listener to work it out; warm, short, and forward.
